title: Spatialproteomics: an interoperable toolbox for analyzing highly multiplexed fluorescence image data

split.decision: No training. Only 40 cores have three-annotator reference labels. Stratified patient-group holdout: 5 of 10 patients per disease (FL 1, DLBCL) allocated to development with both cores together; remaining patients hidden. 20 cores per split, all QC-passed cells retained. Private split and ID randomization seed stored only in NOTES section 9 and judge/split.json; no source identifiers in agent data. Materialized cells: val=267883, test=266384; all 534267 original QC cells accounted for. All 40 raw image and segmentation arrays exactly match source; per-core QC IDs exactly match archive.

baseline.paper_ref: Default quantile level-0 typing vs three-annotator consensus; pooled reproduced kappa=0.96722742603962 on all 534267 QC cells; no paper numeric target.
